response.sql: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), shares AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM project_counts), deviations AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST) AS deviation_rank FROM deviations) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation FROM ranked WHERE deviation_rank <= 10 ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST, arcref;
